title: O'Connell 2012 AF biaxial, circumferential direction held at zero strain (0:1), axial stress vs axial strain (Fig 3b)
condition: mixed degeneration (NP T1rho 46-146 ms); severely degenerate collapsed discs excluded

quantity.name: stress-strain curve
quantity.definition: axial first Piola-Kirchhoff stress P_axial (force / reference cross-sectional area, width x thickness) vs axial 2D Lagrangian strain E_axial (from 4 tracked beads in the centre 1/3) with the circumferential direction held at zero strain (circ-fixed, 0:1); x_value = E as plotted, nominal_strain = sqrt(1+2E) - 1

source.authors: O'Connell GD, Sen S, Elliott DM
source.sample: 16 anterior (outer) AF circ-axial square samples, 7.1+-0.8 x 7.0+-0.8 x 2.1+-0.3 mm (circ x axial x thickness), from L3-L4 and/or L4-L5 discs of 13 lumbar spine sections; no annular fissures. Plotted curve: one test series per strain ratio; whether it is one sample or a mean is not stated (discrete points of a single run)

protocol.summary: Square samples with T-shaped sandpaper tabs, Kevlar threads to 4 motors (biaxial device); PBS bath, room temperature; preload 0.5 N for 10 min (circ and axial); preconditioning 10 cycles 0-2% strain at 1%/s in each direction; reference = first image after preconditioning; strain ratios axial-fixed, 2:1, 1:1, 1:2, circ-fixed with 90 min unloaded recovery between tests; stretched at quasi-static 0.01%/s along the primary direction; stress limited to 1.5 MPa (Sect. 2.1, p.494-495).
how_to_simulate: Model a square anterior AF sample ~7.1 (circ) x 7.0 (axial) x 2.1 mm, lamellae at about +-30 deg to the circumferential direction, loaded on all four edges
Hold the circumferential direction at zero strain in the central region (circ-fixed) and stretch axially at quasi-static rate (0.01%/s) from the post-preconditioning reference state
Report axial nominal stress (force / undeformed width x thickness) vs axial strain of the central 1/3 region up to E_axial ~0.089 (~1 MPa)
protocol.notes: Primary source. Replaces the secondary digitisation from Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7a (passive_tissue.oconnell2012.AF_biaxial_circfixed_axial_curve_secondary, kept on disk); all 14 secondary points agree with this primary digitisation within 0.007 MPa at equal strain (largest: E=0.0228, 0.136 vs 0.141 MPa interpolated). Fig 3a shows circumferential stress only for the other ratios (no circ stress for 0:1), so no transverse (circumferential) stress curve exists for this run. The paper gives no SD for the curves. Model validation in the paper: circ-fixed predictions deviated -0.04 +- 0.09 MPa from experiment.

extraction.uncertainty: strain +-0.001 (E), stress +-0.012 MPa (half symbol diameter at 600 dpi)
extraction.check_notes: Rendered at 600 dpi; axes calibrated on tick marks (x 0-0.10: px 126-1286; y 0-1.0 MPa: px 905.5-46.5); open-circle centroids by connected components, two merged pairs split by k-means (E 0.0343/0.0356; 0.0084 vs 1:2 series point). Series assignment by visual check of a 2x zoom; points below E=0.008 overlap the other ratios and were not used except the origin. Independent check: Ghezelbash 2021 Fig 7a re-plot (secondary file) agrees within 0.007 MPa. x axis label confirms Lagrangian E (secondary file had assumed this).

pass_rule.rule: model curve within the stated digitising uncertainty band of the measured curve over the tested range
